description: Dn-only — drop raw D1-D15 columns. Ablation on diag/d-dn-ablation showed Dn-only outperforms D+Dn across all walk-forward windows (mean AUC-PR 0.6740 vs lower for D+Dn). Raw D columns enable LightGBM to recover calendar day (greedy-attractor effect).
